relationships.subject: Endometriosis
relationships.evidence_quote: Von Frey testing revealed increased abdominal (Fig. 3C) and hind-paw (Fig. 3D) hyperalgesia in endometriotic mice compared to control mice.

key_findings: Endometriosis in mice produces CNS-wide microglial activation (larger soma, increased IBA1 area) from day 8 in cortex, hippocampus, thalamus, hypothalamus and spinal cord, paralleling pain behavior.
Combined-region TNF and IL6 were elevated, with astrocyte GFAP increased in hippocampus at day 16.
